help: usage: fleet-switchboard import-v1 [-h] (--session SESSION | --file FILE) --name NAME [--role ROLE] [--reports-to REPORTS_TO] [--issue ISSUE] [--charter CHARTER] [--tool-output-limit TOOL_OUTPUT_LIMIT] [--dir DIR] [--dry-run] [--json] options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --session SESSION The v1 session id (read with the configured v1 binary's `export`) --file FILE A file holding what v1's `opencode export` printed --name NAME The agent's fleet name (lower case, digits, - and _) --role ROLE metadata.fleet.role --reports-to REPORTS_TO metadata.fleet.reports_to --issue ISSUE metadata.fleet.issue --charter CHARTER metadata.fleet.charter (an orchestrator's charter issue) --tool-output-limit TOOL_OUTPUT_LIMIT Cut each tool output to this many characters (listed as filled in) --dir DIR The session's working directory in v2 (absolute); default: the one v1 recorded --dry-run Convert and check; print what would be imported; write nothing --json Print the report as JSON
